name: Curved Concrete Staircase
description: A curved, cast-in-place concrete stairwell wall built as part of a townhouse development in Pemberton, with Maple Reinders as general contractor. Renova formed and poured the sweeping radius wall and stair run as one continuous structure — the kind of formwork precision decorative curved concrete demands.
